{{Politics of Taiwan}}

This is a list of the [[President of the Republic of China|presidents of the Republic of China]].

The [[Republic of China (1912–1949)|Republic of China]] controlled [[Mainland China]] before 1949. In the fall of 1949, the ROC government [[Retreat of the Republic of China to Taiwan|retreated]] to [[Free area of the Republic of China|Taiwan and surrounding islands]] as a result of the takeover of the mainland by the [[Chinese Communist Party]] and founding of the [[China|People's Republic of China]]. Since 1949, the Republic of China, now commonly known as "[[Taiwan]]", has only controlled Taiwan and nearby islands. Martial law ended in Taiwan in 1987 and [[Presidential elections in Taiwan|direct elections]] were introduced in 1996.

The official name of the office in Chinese has changed as follows:

=== Graphical representation ===
This is a [[Bar chart|graphical]] lifespan timeline of the presidents of the Republic of China (post-1947 Constitution) and they are listed in order of office.

<div style="overflow:auto">
{{#tag:timeline|
Define $width = 1000 # 4 pixels per year ($end - $start) × 4
Define $warning = 880 # $width – 120
Define $height = 325 # 43 x 20 + 160

Define $start = 1887
Define $end = {{CURRENTYEAR}}
Define $now = {{CURRENTYEAR}}

ImageSize  = width:$width height:$height
PlotArea   = right:10 left:1 bottom:80 top:60
Period     = from:$start till:$end
TimeAxis   = orientation:horizontal
Legend = orientation:vertical position:bottom columns:1

Colors =
     id:bg              value:white
     id:lightline       value:rgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
     id:lighttext       value:rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
     id:LIFESPAN        value:rgb(0.88, 0.90, 0.70) Legend: Lifespan
     id:PRES_IND        value:rgb(0.7, 0.7, 0.7) Legend: Independent
     id:PRES_KMT        value:rgb(0, 0, 0.6) Legend: Kuomintang
     id:PRES_DPP        value:rgb(0.1, 0.58, 0.19) Legend: Democratic_Progressive
     id:NAME            value:rgb(0.15, 0.13, 0.05)
     id:TODAY           value:lightpurple

BackgroundColors = canvas:bg
ScaleMinor = gridcolor:lightline unit:year increment:1 start:$start
ScaleMajor = gridcolor:lighttext unit:year increment:10 start:1890

Define $dy = -5 # shift text to button side of bar

LineData=
   at:$now color:TODAY width:0.1

PlotData=
  bar:1 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1887 till:1948 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Chiang Kai-shek]]
    <!--color:PRES_KMT
    from:1928 till:1931
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:1931 till:1943-->
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:1948 till:1949
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:1949 till:1950
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:1950 till:1975

  bar:2 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:left fontsize:M
    from:1905 till:1975 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Yen Chia-kan]]
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:1975 till:1978
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:1978 till:1993

  bar:3 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1910 till:1978 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Chiang Ching-kuo]]
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:1978 till:1988

  bar:4 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1923 till:1988 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Lee Teng-hui]]
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:1988 till:2000
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:2000 till:2020

  bar:5 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1950 till:2000 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Chen Shui-bian]]
    color:PRES_DPP
    from:2000 till:2008
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:2008 till:$now

  bar:6 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1950 till:2008 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Ma Ying-jeou]]
    color:PRES_KMT
    from:2008 till:2016
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:2016 till:$now

  bar:7 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1956 till:2016 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Tsai Ing-wen]]
    color:PRES_DPP
    from:2016 till:2024
    color:LIFESPAN
    from:2024 till:$now

  bar:8 width:18
    color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
    from:1959 till:2024 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:[[Lai Ching-te]]
    color:PRES_DPP
    from:2024 till:$now

TextData =
  fontsize:M
  textcolor:red
  pos:($warning,30)
  text:Updated {{CURRENTMONTH}}/{{CURRENTYEAR}}

TextData =
   pos:(280,$height)
   fontsize:L
   textcolor:black
   text:"Lifespan of each ROC President (post-1947 Constitution)"
}}</div>

Period     = from:0 till:100

ScaleMinor = unit:year increment:1  start:0

  bar:Ma color:alive from:0 till:57.85

  bar:Tsai color:alive from:0 till:59.72

  bar:Tsai color:alive from:67.72 till:  {{a.y|suffix=|1956|8|31}}
